sourcesFound.observation: Official LRIS portal for Jammu and Kashmir, government referenced; reported to provide cadastral map scans and records. No open vector endpoint or coverage of Kulgam/Lanckhul established.
Official NIC State GIS portal gives general base-map layers, not cadastral parcels.

Public React/Vite application and linked bundle inspected. Bundle exposes `/api/v1/get-districts`, `/api/v1/get-tehsil-by-district`, `/api/v1/get-village-by-tehsil`, `/api/v1/get-jamabandi-by-khasra`, and `/api/v1/get-khasra-by-khata`; these are textual records routes, not geometries.

Official LRIS host timed out on one outside-sandbox browser-like request (35 s). Government audit report documents portal function and national government services portal corroborates LRIS; no access-control bypass attempted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: J&K LRIS provides digital cadastral map scans and other land records; cited 2025 audit reports 6,334 of 6,850 maps digitized and 6,163 georeferenced UT-wide, while RoR linkage is partial. Kulgam/Lanckhul coverage not confirmed.

nextStep: If open parcel geometry is required, ask J&K Revenue for a public GIS/data export or use a legally authorized portal path; the currently linked JK-Revenue APIs require authentication and LRIS was temporarily unresponsive. Do not treat this as a negative for cadastral-map existence.
